principle: Recognition builds confidence; production and application prove mastery.

conceptStates.requirement: At least one successful recognition item.
At least one successful production/application item.
Successful production/application on the 7-day review and weighted accuracy at least 85%.

antiInflationRules: Recognition-only answers may contribute no more than 40% of the evidence needed for secure mastery.
Repeated variants of one concept update one concept record, not separate mastery records.
A lucky MC answer cannot override a later failed typed answer.
Identical wording is not repeated within the same ordinary session.
wrongAnswerFlow: Show the complete correct answer and a specific explanation.
Do not immediately repeat the identical card.
Re-present the same concept later through an easier or different format.
Schedule due review after about 2 days and again after about 7 days.
A wrong due review resets the next review to 2 days.

noLifeLoss: first exposure to a preview word
lifeRules.standardLifeLoss: Only after a learner has seen the teaching feedback and misses a previously taught concept.
lifeRules.bossRule: A boss may use lives, but its score report must separate knowledge gaps from spelling/attention errors.

extensionNote: Chemistry and Physics use the same recognition/production weights, 2-day and 7-day repair cycle, and anti-inflation rules as Master_Content_Pack_V1.
